authority.owner_request: Find a Demo strategy with two AIs and the actual shared AI Room; execute promptly.

mechanism.feature: absolute publisher-label quote-notional imbalance and its collapse; not asserted taker/maker flow or L2 absorption
mechanism.quote_sum: Q_label=sum(price*volume) across all raw trades with that literal CSV side, including rpi=0 and rpi=1
mechanism.novelty: Two tick streams can have identical OHLCV and different label concentration. Extra predictive value must survive the identical price-only ablation.
mechanism.source_semantics: Official REST/WS fields mean taker side; exact historical CSV mapping remains unverified and is not required by this invariant feature.

signal.entry: First raw trade/open in bar t+1; decision grid time equals t close; actual entry timestamp is first_trade_ms and must be >= decision time.
signal.tie_break: BTCUSDT then ETHUSDT, consider next symbol if first fails entry distance; no candidate ranking optimization

execution.target: T=E+2*(E-S), price-distance R before exit costs
open_exit_order: if open<=S: stop gap at open
else if open>=T: target at T, no favorable improvement
else if current index>=entry index+6: time exit at open
intrabar_exit_order: else if high>=T: target at T
execution.terminal: Last permitted Oct18 bar close at adverse costs; never read Oct19 prices.
execution.marking: 4h close mark-to-market equity; report maximum close-mark drawdown explicitly, not guaranteed intrabar/gap loss ceiling.

controls.price_only_ablation: Remove only both imbalance gates. Keep all remaining price, stop, timing, sizing and selection rules identical.
passive: 50/50 BTCUSDT ETHUSDT 250-USDT gross cap plus cash

one_decision.exploratory_pass: Candidate net PnL>0 for all three cost profiles AND candidate stress net PnL>price-only stress net PnL AND candidate stress net PnL>250-gross passive50/50 stress net PnL AND candidate stress maximum close-mark DD<=250-gross passive50/50 stress maximum close-mark DD.
one_decision.failure: terminal negative for this exact contract; do not loosen thresholds or try critic alternative
one_decision.positive: new-input exploratory lead only; untouched validation and separate Demo admission still required

before_economic_replay: hash every retained raw file and receipt against pinned capture
independently reconstruct quote sums with Decimal on all raw rows
cross-check all 948 OHLCV bars against existing independently reconstructed source
synthetic gap, both-hit, time, costs, shared-cash and side-flip checks
after: independent reconstruction of signal gates and all fills/cash/equity/fees/PnL
publish every trade, close mark, monthly PnL, exit reasons and all comparator outcomes

deepseek.position: Rejects OHLCV-only novelty; requests genuinely new input; this is not its approval of the present system.

ai_provenance.codex_design: /root/demo_novelty_inventory fixed .20/.05 candidate selected before price reads
ai_provenance.codex_critic: /root/demo_strategy_critic agrees only exploratory invariant feature with no-flow control; its .25/.10 alternative is not tested
ai_provenance.perplexity: fresh request unsubmitted, actual IP access blocked, no circumvention
ai_provenance.claude: fresh request unsubmitted, observed App unavailable in region, no circumvention

research_limit: The cited 15-minute study reports ~1.3 bps gross edge versus 5 bps round-trip cost; it does not validate this 4h adaptation or overcome our 30/50/80 bps approximate round-trip assumptions.
registration: Git commit timestamp is authoritative; committed before opening raw prices for this new feature study.
